       function DeleteTab(obj) {
            if($(".selecttab").length == 1) {
                CustomAlert("Last tab can not be deleted.", "Warning", "warning");
                return false;
            }else {

                CustomConfirmdialog('Are you sure you want to delete this tab?', function(data) {
                    if (data) {
                        $.post('/WidgetHandler.ashx', { MethodName: 'DeleteTabs', ID: jQuery(obj).parent().attr('xml:lang'), PageID: '2', tabID: 8 , _: $.now()}, function(data2) {
                            if (data2 == "0") {
                                CustomAlert("Last tab can not be deleted.", "Warning", "warning");
                            } else {
                                window.document.location.href = "default.aspx?tabid=" + data2;
                            }
                        });
                    }
                });
            }
            return false;
        }

            $("body").on("click", ".drbox form .widgetssavebutton",function(event) {
                var from = this;
                var form = $(this).closest("form");
                form.validate({
                    errorPlacement: function (error, element) {

                    },
                    invalidHandler: function (e, validator) {
                        var errors = validator.numberOfInvalids();
                        if (errors) {

                           $(form).find("div.verror").remove();
                            $(form).find(".editpanel").append("<div class='verror' />");


                            var message = "";
                      
                            $(validator.errorList).each(function (key, val) {
                                //only add unique errors
                                if (message.indexOf(val.message) == -1) message += "<span class='rred'>* " + val.message + "</span><br />";
                            });
                            $(form).find("div.verror").html(message);
                            $(form).find("div.verror").show();
                        } else {
                            $(form).find("div.verror").hide();
                        }
                    }
                });
                var isValid = form.valid();


                if (isValid) {
                
                    var portlet = $(from).closest(".dragbox");
                    $.post(form.attr("action"), form.serialize(), function(result) {
                        $('#drbox' + portlet.attr("xml:lang")).html(result);
                    });
                }

                return false; 
          

            });

<script type="text/javascript">
    var licenseIsFilledIn = true;
    var hasRights = '1';

    $(document).ready(function () {
        licenseIsFilledIn = getIsLicenseFilledIn();
        if (hasRights === '0' && !licenseIsFilledIn) {
            $("#emailCaptureOverlay").show();
            $('#emailCaptureModal_screen2').hide();
            $('#btnSubmitKey').hide();
            $('.errorBlock').hide();
            $('.errorBlock').next().hide();
            $('#emailSubmitContainer_screen4').show();
            $('#emailCaptureModal_screen4').show();
            $("#emailCaptureModal").css({ "min-height": "300px" });
            $("#emailCaptureOverlay").show();
            if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
                $('#firstrunOverlay').hide();
            }
        } else {
            if (!licenseIsFilledIn) {
                initiateUnlockArea($('#keyArea'), isValidLicense);
                if (!(typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun)) {
                    $("#emailCaptureOverlay").show();
                    if (!doesConnectionExist()) {
                        $('#emailSubmitContainer_screen2').show();
                        $('#emailSubmitContainer_screen1').hide();
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        //dirty fix for jquery ui focus stealing bug
        if (window.jQuery && window.jQuery.ui.dialog) {
            setTimeout(function() {
                $(document).unbind("focusin.dialog");
            }, 500);
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', '.submitKey', function(e) {
        // if valid license, remove overlay
        var license = $(this).parent().find('.keyArea').val();
        var container = $(this).parents("div").first();
        var errorBlock = container.find(".errorBlock");

        if (unlocked) {
            openActivationTab(activationUrl);
        }

        if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
            ShowLoading();
        }
        
        var valid = checkIsValidLicense(license, errorBlock);

        if (valid) {
            saveLicense(license);

            //Open tab when activationUrl is available
            licenseIsFilledIn = true;

            if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
                firstRunNextContinue();
            }
            else {
                location.reload();
            }
        }
        else {
            $(this).parent().find('fieldset').css('border-color', '#ff0000');
            $(this).parent().find('.keyArea').css('color', '#ff0000');
        }
        if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
            HideLoading();
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#btnContinue', function (e) {
        // remove overlay and continue the first run wizard
        $("#emailCaptureOverlay").remove();
        if (typeof isFirstRun !== 'undefined' && isFirstRun) {
            location.reload();
        }
    });

    $(document).on('click', '#btnBackToLoginKey', function (e) {
        location.href = "/login.aspx?lo=1";
    });

    $(document).on('paste', '#keyArea', function () {
        $('.errorBlock').html('');
    });

    function doesConnectionExist() {
        var url = "https://lansweeper.azure-api.net/ls-instances/unlock";
        var success = false;
        $.ajax({
            type: 'GET',
            url: url,
            complete: function (response) {
                if (response.status !== 503 && response.status !== 0){ success = true;}
            },
            async: false
        });
        return success;
    }
</script>
